record: Taipei Department of Cultural Affairs bathed landmark guide
facts: The lower floor is masonry with brick and concrete and stained glass. The second floor is timber and the roof projects to shelter the front entrance.

record: Taipei Department of Cultural Affairs public bathhouse dossier
facts: Completed in 1913, the two-storey building had an upper public entrance with a pavilion and genkan. It reopened as a municipal museum in 1998.
The 1913 public baths were supervised by architect Moriyama Matsunosuke and combined Japanese and Western architecture.
